name: Louis XVI
source:
“I’ll say it now; I have no interest in marriage. And I have no interest in you.  Go ahead and spend your time as you wish.”

Born in France.
Hobby: Hunting, Making Locks, Reading
Likes: Nothing in Particular
Dislikes: Nothing in Particular

The crown prince of France and the eventual king. Perturbed by nothing, an apathetic and unimpressed man.  He feels he is unsuited to being the crown prince, and views everything in the long term.

[From [url=http://dreamer-chan.tumblr.com/post/145074546359/bara-ni-kakusareshi-verite-main-cast]Tumblr[/url]]
